# Bibcitation

> Bibcitation is a free online citation generator supporting multiple academic formats (MLA, APA, Chicago, Harvard, Vancouver, MHRA, OSCOLA, IEEE) to automate bibliography creation and in-text citations for students and researchers.

Bibcitation provides automated citation generation tools for academic writing across major citation styles, complemented by comprehensive guides, writing resources, and organizational integration features. The platform helps students and institutions manage citations, combat misinformation, and improve academic writing quality.

## Key Topics

## Citation Generators

- [Free MLA Citation & Bibliography Generator](https://www.bibcitation.com/mla): Automatic MLA citation generator for works cited and in-text citations
- [Free Chicago Citation & Bibliography Generator](https://www.bibcitation.com/chicago): Automatic Chicago citation generator supporting notes-bibliography and author-date systems
- [Free Harvard Citation & Bibliography Generator](https://www.bibcitation.com/harvard): Automatic Harvard citation generator for academic writing and reference lists
- [Free Vancouver Citation & Bibliography Generator](https://www.bibcitation.com/vancouver): Automatic Vancouver citation generator for academic referencing and works cited
- [Free MHRA Citation & Bibliography Generator](https://www.bibcitation.com/mhra): Automatic MHRA citation generator for humanities research with footnote formatting
- [Free OSCOLA Citation & Bibliography Generator](https://www.bibcitation.com/oscola): Automatic OSCOLA citation generator for legal referencing and footnote formatting

## Citation Guides & Documentation

- [Complete Guide to MLA Format: Generating Citations and Works Cited](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog/mla-format.html): Complete guide to MLA format, works cited, and in-text citation creation
- [Guide to Chicago Style Citations](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog/chicago-format.html): Guide to Chicago style citations including footnotes and bibliography formatting
- [Guide to APA Format & Citations](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog/apa-format.html): Guide to APA format including reference lists and in-text citation creation
- [Cite a Website in MLA, APA and Chicago Formats](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog/citation-guides/cite-website-mla-apa-chicago.html): Guide to citing websites in MLA, APA, and Chicago citation formats

## Academic Writing Resources

- [Bibcitation Blog](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog): Collection of academic resources, citation guides, writing tips, and student blogs
- [5 Tips for Writing a Great Essay](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog/writing/tips-great-essay.html): Essay writing tips covering structure, research, and citation integration
- [The Benefits of Academic Writing](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog/writing/disagree-with-your-professor.html): Article on academic writing and essay composition for student success
- [Bibcitation Against Fake News](https://www.bibcitation.com/blog/academic-resources/bibcitation-against-fake-news.html): Article exploring how citations and bibliography tools combat misinformation
